source.title: Continental Championship Locations & Championship Announcements
source.content:
It is with great pleasure that we announce the winning candidates to host the upcoming continental championships in 2020:

**WCA Asian Championship 2020** will be held on August 27-30, 2020 in **Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia**.
**WCA European Championship 2020** will be held on July 16-19, 2020 in **Almere, Netherlands**.
**WCA North American Championship 2020** will be held on June 25-28, 2020 in **Toronto, Canada**.

All dates and locations are tentative until the competitions are announced on the WCA website.

The decision for WCA Oceanian Championship 2020 has been deferred.

There were no applications for continental championships in Africa or South America and thus no continental championships will be held in these continents in 2020.
<!-- break -->

The public versions of the applications are available [here](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Da139yb65r8V1NQLmqi2Zo1rTM1GKRAa?usp=sharing). The public version of the Oceanian Championship application will be published after a decision is made.

Additionally, we would like to announce a few changes to the calendar and requirements of future championship applications.

As a result of feedback, the WCA Board agreed to announce further in advance the calendar for upcoming championship applications, as seen below:


| **Type** | **Year** | **Location** | **Applications open** | **Applications close** | **Board decision** |
| :--------- | :--------- | :--------- | :--------- | :--------- | :--------- |
| World | 2021 | World | January 1, 2020 | March 31, 2020 | April 30, 2020 |
| Continental | 2022 | Asia | March 1, 2020 | May 31, 2020 | June 30, 2020* |
| | | Europe | | | |
| | | North America | | | |
| | | Africa | June 1, 2020 | August 31, 2020 | September 30, 2020* |
| | | Oceania | | | |
| | | South America | | | |
| World | 2023 | World | March 1, 2021 | May 31, 2021 | June 30, 2021* |
| Continental | 2024 | Asia | January 1, 2022 | March 31, 2022 | April 30, 2022* |
| | | Europe | | | |
| | | North America | | | |
| | | Africa | April 1, 2022 | June 30, 2022 | July 31, 2022* |
| | | Oceania | | | |
| | | South America | | | |
*Announce at the previous competition if one exists
Note that the goal will be to announce future championships two years in advance instead of one year to allow for further planning time for organization teams, so future applications will be due earlier than expected.


Additionally, it is our aim to require Continental and World Championship applications for 2023 and beyond to be submitted with the support of a WCA Regional Organization. As the budgets of WCA continental and world championships have grown to regularly exceed $100,000, it has become essential to ensure financial accountability through an established corporate entity and require a simple agreement between the WCA and the organization team to outline each organization’s responsibilities with regard to the event. We are announcing this requirement now so that all potential organization teams for these competitions have sufficient time to register a Regional Organization if they do not already have one.

translation.title: 洲际锦标赛举办地及今后锦标赛申办安排
translation.content:
我们很高兴公布 2020 年洲际锦标赛的获选举办地：

**2020 年 WCA 亚洲锦标赛**将于 2020 年 8 月 27–30 日在**马来西亚吉隆坡**举行。

**2020 年 WCA 欧洲锦标赛**将于 2020 年 7 月 16–19 日在**荷兰阿尔梅勒**举行。

**2020 年 WCA 北美锦标赛**将于 2020 年 6 月 25–28 日在**加拿大多伦多**举行。

在比赛正式公布于 WCA 网站之前，以上日期和地点均为暂定。

2020 年 WCA 大洋洲锦标赛举办地的决定已推迟。

非洲和南美洲没有收到申办申请，因此这两个洲在 2020 年不会举办洲际锦标赛。

<!-- break -->

申办材料的公开版本见[此处](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Da139yb65r8V1NQLmqi2Zo1rTM1GKRAa?usp=sharing)。大洋洲锦标赛申办材料的公开版本将在决定作出后公布。

此外，我们也将调整今后锦标赛的申办时间安排及要求。

根据收到的反馈，WCA 董事会同意更早公布锦标赛申办日程，安排如下：

| **类型** | **年份** | **地区** | **申办开始** | **申办截止** | **董事会决定** |
| :--------- | :--------- | :--------- | :--------- | :--------- | :--------- |
| 世界锦标赛 | 2021 | 全球 | 2020 年 1 月 1 日 | 2020 年 3 月 31 日 | 2020 年 4 月 30 日 |
| 洲际锦标赛 | 2022 | 亚洲 | 2020 年 3 月 1 日 | 2020 年 5 月 31 日 | 2020 年 6 月 30 日* |
| | | 欧洲 | | | |
| | | 北美洲 | | | |
| | | 非洲 | 2020 年 6 月 1 日 | 2020 年 8 月 31 日 | 2020 年 9 月 30 日* |
| | | 大洋洲 | | | |
| | | 南美洲 | | | |
| 世界锦标赛 | 2023 | 全球 | 2021 年 3 月 1 日 | 2021 年 5 月 31 日 | 2021 年 6 月 30 日* |
| 洲际锦标赛 | 2024 | 亚洲 | 2022 年 1 月 1 日 | 2022 年 3 月 31 日 | 2022 年 4 月 30 日* |
| | | 欧洲 | | | |
| | | 北美洲 | | | |
| | | 非洲 | 2022 年 4 月 1 日 | 2022 年 6 月 30 日 | 2022 年 7 月 31 日* |
| | | 大洋洲 | | | |
| | | 南美洲 | | | |

*如有上一届赛事，将在上一届比赛中公布。

我们的目标是将下一届锦标赛的公布时间从提前一年改为提前两年，让组织团队有更多筹备时间。因此，今后的申办截止时间会比大家原先预期的更早。

此外，我们计划要求 2023 年及之后的洲际锦标赛和世界锦标赛申办获得 WCA 地区组织的支持。WCA 洲际及世界锦标赛的预算不断增长，超过 10 万美元已很常见。因此，有必要由正式成立的法人实体承担财务责任，并要求 WCA 与组织团队签署一份简明协议，写清各方在赛事中的职责。我们现在提前公布这一要求，是为了让有意申办的团队有充分时间注册地区组织（如尚未注册）。
